## Talk plan

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="68%"}
- Two events, each seen through a window, and the bias from ignoring
  that
- Eighteen Stan branches against three closed forms and one fallback,
  picked by the type
- What Stan cost us, an integral solver that would not hold and two
  integer tables that disagreed
- The honest part, R has about a hundred times the downloads
- The numerical problem moved into autodiff, it did not go away
- What I would use today, and why the composition outlasts the package
:::
